environmentGuard.dotenv: default non-overriding; DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH points to nonexistent file
environmentGuard.application: DATABASE_URL replaced in process memory before any import or child spawn; each child explicitly receives it
environmentGuard.pool: pg.Pool.connect validates owned scratch name and configured target before every application pool connection
environmentGuard.maintenance: postgres maintenance connection only: pg_database names and exact owned CREATE/DROP; no main/demo connection
environmentGuard.childOutput: withheld entirely; only named exit statuses recorded
